user.title: Use the existing G2H Matter pairing
user.description: Select the G2H camera already paired with this Matter integration. If it is absent, first add the current camera through the Matter integration using its camera pairing code. This extension then uses that same pairing. Matter server API schema: {schema}.

error.camera_api_missing: The Matter server reports API schema {schema}; camera signalling needs schema 12 or newer.
error.no_camera: The selected camera is no longer available.
error.not_g2h_camera: This Matter device is not the G2H Matter camera. Select the existing Linux camera, not the old radio pairing.
error.matter_read_failed: Could not read the selected Matter camera. Check that it is available in the Matter integration.

abort.no_camera: No already paired G2H Matter camera was found.
abort.camera_api_missing: The Matter server reports API schema <12; camera signalling needs schema 12 or newer.
abort.not_g2h_camera: This Matter device is not the G2H Matter camera. Select the existing Linux camera, not the old radio pairing.
abort.matter_read_failed: Could not read the selected Matter camera. Check that it is available in the Matter integration.
